default.description: Least privilege for every Cortex window: the engine commands, the engine and settings events, opening windows through the shell, and showing, hiding, sizing, positioning and dragging our own windows. No shell, fs or other plugins.

onboarding.description: The first-run tour: only the onboarding window may route the record shortcut to itself while it teaches it.

preview.description: The live preview hole: only the main window may place the native preview view or turn it on.

trim.description: Quick trim: only the Trim window may read timeline thumbnails and waveforms, export a trimmed file or cancel an export.

troubleshooting.description: Settings › Advanced › Troubleshooting: only the Settings window may open the log folder in the file manager. The webview never reads the log; the shell opens the folder it writes to (src/logfile.rs).

updates.description: Software updates: only the Settings window and the menu bar panel may read the update status, check the feed or install the announced (signed) update. No window gets the updater or process plugin's own permissions; checking and installing run in Rust (src/updater.rs).
